mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Dept (pid, dname, captain) VALUES (#{pid}, #{dname}, #{captain})
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE CteDept(id, pid, dname, depth, h, captain) AS ( SELECT id, pid, dname, 0, CAST(id AS CHAR(10)), captain FROM Dept WHERE pid = 0 UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.pid, d.dname, depth + 1, CONCAT(c.h, '-', d.id), d.captain FROM CteDept c INNER JOIN Dept d ON c.id = d.pid ) SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(cte_max_recursion_depth = 20) */ CONCAT(REPEAT('↳', c.depth), ' ', c.dname) AS hierarchy, c.depth, c.id AS deptId, c.captain AS captainId, e.ename AS captainName, c.dname FROM CteDept c LEFT JOIN Emp e ON c.captain = e.id ORDER BY c.h;
